comments.value: I know that when the group's system launches it will have roles already, but I'm mainly focused on the XP thing here and how it could feed into Tupper's initial idea of how the roles/titles will work, role gain based on XP is one of those things, as well as customizable roles for levels, not necessarily just the strict "admin, officer, member" idea in tupper's original group post. This is expanding on that system. Allows for more freedom in how people in the group sort themselves.

details:
When the groups system is released, I think it would also be interesting if it had some sort of group XP system. How I imagine this would work is any person who holds a specific role, that could be designated by the group's owner, should be able to mark an instance they're in as a group event. When you join a group event, or when an instance that you're in is designated as a group event, you get experience for being there. This experience could feed into a leveling system that gives roles/titles in the group.
E.G. A group focused around hosting weekend parties that may be *too* big for a single instance can have multiple members of the group that are allowed to designate an instance as an event for the group. You join off one of these members, who would most likely be some kind of moderator or group authority, and they designate that instance as an event, then while you're in the lobby you begin earning experience points in the group. When you reach level 10 in the group you get the title of "master partier". XP gain could scale based on the size of the instance so there's incentive to show up to large events.
I think this would also feed into the meta-game of trying to find a clique and sticking with them. Right now people already do this with discord groups and I think that is part of the fun of the game, even if it's not intended. If this feature were brought in it would add a tad of social linearity and provide new players with an idea of what they should be going for when socializing and keep them active.
Keep in mind, the way I'm envisioning this it would ONLY apply to people in groups, so casual players who maybe don't want to be locked into any group or don't like the linearity could easily just ignore the system entirely. I think an overall vrchat leveling system would be a bad idea, we have the trust ranks already.
This system could also feed into udon so that anyone with a certain amount of XP in a certain group can access world-specific features at the discretion of the world author.
title: Experience and rank system for the upcoming groups feature
